clips.title: The story
paras: In eastern Ashenvale, Kayneth Stillwind watches the Forsaken draw nearer. He fears they are brewing blights to ravage sacred elven lands, and sends Alliance champions toward a camp near Dor'Danil Barrow Den to seize a sample.

Ashenvale's night elves have long faced satyrs, raging elementals, and orcish logging crews. The Forsaken bring a darker threat. The undead arm of the Horde is taking root near ancient ruins and sacred barrow dens. Their presence brings war and the fear of alchemical plague spreading through Kaldorei groves.

South of Forest Song, near Dor'Danil Barrow Den, Forsaken apothecaries and scouts have fortified a camp. They bottle untested toxins among brewing caldrons and foul reagents. Kayneth Stillwind sends scouts inside to recover an intact Bottle of Disease, so its volatile contents can be studied before the Forsaken unleash it across the forest.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The Forsaken, the undead arm of the Horde, have crept into Ashenvale, lurking at our ruins and our barrows. We believe their goal is to spread disease amongst the lands of the night elves. We must confirm this!

The Forsaken have a camp south of here, near the Dor'Danil Barrow Den, where they create poisons and diseases and place them in bottles. Fight your way into that camp and steal a bottle of disease. Return with such a bottle. I will test it and find its purpose.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Did you find the camp, friend? Do you have a bottle of disease?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Very good, friend. Now... By testing the contents of this bottle, the goals of the Forsaken will be revealed!
